name: KenyonExpress - Revenue cohorts
description: Ledger-sourced revenue facts (revenue.purchase, revenue.refund) shipped by src/server/analytics/revenue-facts.ts. Amounts are integer agorot; divide by 100 for shekels. Cohort is the Asia/Jerusalem month of the customer's first paid order.

query.apl: ['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'revenue.' | summarize net_agorot = sum(signed_amount_agorot)
['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event == 'revenue.purchase' | summarize first_orders = countif(is_first_order == true), repeat_orders = countif(is_first_order == false)
['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'revenue.' | summarize sum(signed_amount_agorot) by bin_auto(_time), kind

['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'revenue.' | summarize customers = dcount(customer_key), orders = dcount(order_id), net_agorot = sum(signed_amount_agorot) by cohort_month | sort by cohort_month desc | limit 24

charts.name: Cohort x months since first order (net agorot)

query.apl: ['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'revenue.' and isnotnull(months_since_first_order) | summarize active_customers = dcount(customer_key), net_agorot = sum(signed_amount_agorot) by cohort_month, months_since_first_order | sort by cohort_month desc, months_since_first_order asc | limit 200
['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'revenue.' | summarize sum(signed_amount_agorot) by bin_auto(_time), cashback_tier
['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event == 'revenue.purchase' | summarize purchases = dcount(order_id), gross_agorot = sum(amount_agorot) by checkout_variant | sort by purchases desc

charts.name: Net revenue by UTM source / campaign (agorot)

query.apl: ['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event startswith 'revenue.' | summarize orders = dcount(order_id), net_agorot = sum(signed_amount_agorot) by utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign | sort by net_agorot desc | limit 20
['{{revenue_dataset}}'] | where event == 'revenue.purchase' | summarize purchases = dcount(order_id), gross_agorot = sum(amount_agorot) by product_types | sort by gross_agorot desc
